justification: Panel A depicts a procession of figures leading tribute animals (rams) past a tree, rendered in naturalistic profile relief typical of narrative processional art, while Panel B shows a dense grid of small seated/kneeling figures interspersed with columns of script-like signs, a composition typical of inscribed stelae. The only broad commonality is the presence of standing/seated human figures in profile, but their number, activity, scale relative to the surface, and combination with other elements (animals and a tree vs. hieroglyphic-like text blocks) are entirely different, so no specific shared iconographic scheme is evident.
